component.name: Night Light for COSMIC
component.summary: Warm screen color temperature to reduce eye strain on a schedule

description.p: Night Light is a native panel applet and settings application for the COSMIC desktop environment (Pop!_OS) that warms your screen color temperature to cut blue light.
Built entirely with native libcosmic widgets, it seamlessly integrates with your COSMIC panel or dock.

ul.li: Quick toggle and temperature slider directly from the panel popup
Custom schedule support to set active hours to the exact minute
Screen brightness dimming control while active
Direct kernel DRM integration for screen color control

screenshot.caption: Panel applet popup with temperature control and toggle
Settings window for custom schedules and brightness

description.p: Night Light can now be installed as a flatpak, and sets itself up the first time you turn it on.

ul.li: Turning the night light on for the first time installs what it needs and applies the change together, so it asks for a password once and then never again
A settings row offers the same setup if that prompt was dismissed, and offers to update what it installed when a new release needs it
The app has an icon of its own and describes itself properly to software centers
The note about the screen briefly flickering now appears in the settings window as well as the applet
Uninstalling removes a flatpak install too, un-registers the panel applet, and resets the screen tint on the way out

description.p: The applet now keeps to the schedule by itself, so nothing has to run in the background for the screen to warm up on time.

ul.li: Schedule times are minute-precise: From and To each pick an hour, minute, and AM/PM
A brightness slider dims the screen while the night light is on
A daytime window such as 9:00AM to 5:00PM no longer leaves the tint on around the clock
The tint is re-applied after resuming from suspend
Applies run off the UI thread, so the toggle and sliders stay responsive
The "Start on login" toggle is gone; enable the systemd user service to run without the applet
"Start on login" is honored again: the package no longer auto-enables the systemd user service
Autostart entries and units left by the pre-rename "nightshift" version are cleared on upgrade
Uninstalling stops the daemon, removes the autostart entry, and resets the screen tint

description.p: Renamed from "Night Shift" to "Night Light". Settings move to ~/.config/cosmic/io.github.cosmic_nightlight/ and are not carried over automatically.

ul.li: A manual on/off override that takes precedence over the schedule and clears at the next transition
Settings sync live between the applet, settings window, and daemon
The settings window mirrors the applet's toggle and follows the system 12/24-hour clock

description.p: The GUI moves into a COSMIC panel applet.

ul.li: Panel icon with a popup for the on/off toggle and temperature slider
A separate settings window for the schedule and night temperature
Settings are shared across the applet, settings window, and daemon

description.p: First release: a libcosmic GUI, a systemd user scheduler, and the privileged DRM gamma helper invoked through polkit.
